sections.heading: Revisit of T-GLOBAL-TSM-001
sections.markdown:
**Why the prior died (Bear, 2026-09-16, KILL_RECOMMENDED).** Not a fundamentals error: Drew accepted the margins and killed on (1) negative EV by own arithmetic (p 0.50, +15%/-30%, quarter-Kelly 0), (2) base-case DCF ~= spot, so no margin of safety, (3) a $300 kill that sat above the real tail, (4) no dated catalyst, (5) edge self-refuted. Post-kill scoring (LESSON-0003) was TSM +14.3%: the kill under-weighted the AI complex.

**New evidence (fundamental, dated after the kill).** Sep-2026 quarter, dossier asof 2026-11-18: revenue TWD 1,494.2bn (+17.6% QoQ), EBIT 876.4bn (OM 58.7%), net income 763.1bn. The prior's named test (review if OM <54%) did not fire; the step-up survived a third quarter (Q1 58.1%, Q2 60.3%, Q3 58.7%; 9M 59.0%). Nine-month revenue TWD 3,898.7bn already runs ahead of the prior's ~US$170bn FY26E (my FY26E 5,468 is 1.8% above that at 31.6).

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: Market narrative: irreplaceable AI foundry, margins the new normal.

sections.heading: EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate
sections.markdown:
- Accruals (NI-CFO)/avg assets: FY23 -7.4%, FY24 -10.9%, FY25 -7.9% (CFO 2,275.0 vs NI 1,697.6; avg assets 7,312.3). Cash outruns earnings; no flag.
- Divergence: CFO/NI 1.58x (FY24) to 1.34x (FY25) while EBIT margin rose 45.7% to 50.8%: margin up with weaker cash conversion. Mild; haircut: FCFE conversion modelled at 60% of NI, below FY24's 74%.
- NI/EBIT was 92.2% in Q2'26 vs 87.1% in Q3: non-operating income is a swing factor. I use 88.5% (9M average 88.7%).
- Capex/revenue 48.1%, 44.2%, 33.3%, 33.7% (FY22-25); FCF FY25 992.4 = 58% of NI.
- Related-party, pledging, IDX flags: n/a. Gate clears. Dossier is Yahoo-sourced: verify against the 20-F.

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
FY26E: nine months actual revenue 3,898.7, EBIT 2,301.9, NI 2,042.2 (Mar/Jun/Sep quarters). Q4 assumed +5% QoQ to 1,569 at 58% OM: FY26E revenue 5,468, EBIT 3,212 (58.7%), NI 2,849, EPS 549 per ADS. DPS is a low-weight assumption (FY25 paid 466.8 = 27.5% payout).

**Load-bearing assumptions (carry >70% of value):**
1. *Revenue path.* FY27E +20% to 6,562. The Q4'26E run-rate alone (1,569 x 4 = 6,276) is already +14.8% over FY26E, so +20% needs only ~+2% sequential growth per quarter. Fades to +12/+10/+8/+6%.
2. *Through-cycle operating margin 51-52%.* Base falls from 59% (9M26) to 55% FY27E, 52% FY28E, 51% terminal. Cites: EBIT margins FY22 49.5%, FY23 42.6%, FY24 45.7%, FY25 50.8%; four-year mean 47.1%. Terminal sits ~4pp above that mean because FY25 and the last three quarters show a step-up; 59% is not assumed to persist.
3. *Reinvestment and cash.* FCFE conversion 60% of NI rising to 75% by FY31, terminal 82% (g 3.5% / ROE ~20%). Cites: capex 1,282.6 vs CFO 2,275.0; FY25 FCF/NI 58%.
**Valuation per ADS (TWD):** bear 6,406 / base 9,953 / bull 12,489. USD equivalents (~US$203 / 315 / 395) use 31.6 TWD/USD, the rate implied by TSMC's reported Q1-Q2'26 USD and TWD revenue. Phase 2 re-converts at spot. Base is ~18x FY26E EPS, below the prior thesis' ~$418-445 (5-year fade and FCFE haircut).

**Not yet carried (no source in the Phase 1 packet):** hyperscaler capex guides, utilisation, customer concentration, export-control and Taiwan-geography downside numbers (card items 1-3). UNAVAILABLE here; Phase 2 to source. Until then only the bull case carries the AI complex.

sections.heading: Macro regime
sections.markdown: Quoted from the macro regime memo frontmatter, unaltered: "regime: balance_of_payments_pressure", "risk_appetite: CAUTIOUS". All five tilts are Indonesia/commodity scoped; none names semis or Taiwan, so the regime gives no tilt for TSM. The Fed path is listed UNVERIFIED in the markers.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the margin step-up is permanent.
**Why wrong:** the step-up is real for three quarters and in FY25's 50.8%, but a 51-52% through-cycle margin (not 59%) is what the base underwrites, about 18x FY26E EPS. Edge tag: (a) analytical.
**What proves us wrong:** Q4'26 OM at or above 58% with revenue still growing QoQ and FY27 revenue above +28%, i.e. the bull path.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Q3'26 OM 58.7% < Q2 60.3%: first sequential margin slip (dossier quarterly table).
2. CFO/NI 1.58x to 1.34x and FCF/NI 74% to 58% (FY24 to FY25): cash conversion fell as margin rose; capex/revenue 33.7% is a fixed commitment.
3. FY22 OM 49.5% to FY23 42.6%: a 7pp one-year drop already happened within the last four years, the reversion path the bear case uses.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is end-2027 and this position lost 30%. Most likely cause: OM slid toward 52% as new capacity depreciated (EBITDA minus EBIT was 806bn in FY25 vs 757bn in FY24 and is rising), revenue stalled at the Q4 run-rate, and the market stopped paying for the step-up. Second: the price paid; far above the 9,953 base, the loss is the multiple.

sections.heading: Phase 2: market data, entry, EV
sections.markdown:
**Spot.** TSM US$318.71 (the price snapshot, 2026-11-20), down 9.5% from 352.09 on 11-19; cause not in the packet. At spot the base target 315 is 1.2% below price: up -1.2%, down -36.3% to the 203 kill. EV about -18.7%. This is not a long at spot; it is PASS-at-a-price.

**Entry 240 as revised (limit, chase 3%, valid to 2027-02-20; was 250, see Revision).** At 240 vs fixed 315/203: up +31.3%, down -15.4%, dividend 1.0%/yr net (~US$3.2 after withholding), 0.75y horizon, drag 0.3: expected = 0.5(31.3+0.75) - 0.5(15.4) - 0.3 = +8.0%. Ratio 2.0 vs library 1.36; sizing small.
**Variant perception.** Edge (a) analytical, weak. No timing edge claimed; the 1-month-reversal filter is not passed (stock just broke down).

**AI-complex reading (LESSON-0003).** Hyperscaler capex guides: UNAVAILABLE in packet. The bull case (US$395) carries the complex; the -9.5% day suggests it is being cut.

**Ownership checklist.** 13F, insider, index, short interest: UNAVAILABLE.

**FX (TWD/USD).** TWD spot UNAVAILABLE in cache; the 31.6 implied rate is retained, not a market quote. Earnings are TWD, the ADS trades in USD: a 1% TWD move shifts the USD target and kill roughly 1%.

**Conviction 2/5.** Fundamentals fine, price not. Liquidity: ADR highly liquid, days-to-exit trivial. Correlation: AI/semis beta to any held US tech.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**Drew (BEAR) attack on T-GLOBAL-TSM-002**

1. Fact-check clean: 9M sums, OM 58.1/60.3/58.7, EPS 549 (2,849/5.1865bn), USD conversions and EV +3.7% reproduce from the dossier. But load-bearing #3 (FCFE conversion 60% to 75%) cites only FY25 FCF/NI; the dossier has no FY26 capex or CFO while revenue runs +43%. [MATERIAL]
2. Widest error bar is terminal OM. The thesis's own four-year mean is 47.1%; base uses 51% on three quarters. At 47% (NI-linear, about -8%) base is ~US$290: at 250, up +16% vs down -18.8%, EV about -1.3%. Fragile, single-assumption dependency. [MATERIAL]
3. The fill is adverse selection. A 250 limit fills only after a further -22%. ACWI fell 3.49% the same day (the price snapshot, 2026-11-20): TSM's -9.5% is ~2.7x market beta, not a clean AI-complex signal. The fill-state is risk-off, where p_up sits below 0.50 and the kill is 19% away. [MATERIAL]
4. Archetype mislabeled. momentum_continuation fails its own 1-month-reversal filter, and the payoff is DCF, not the registry's +30/-22. This is a value limit-buy borrowing a momentum prior; p_up 0.50 has no evidence under it. [MATERIAL]
5. Construction, other direction: haircuts stack. Base fell from ~US$418-445 (TSM-001) to 315 while 9M revenue ran ahead. FCFF-to-FCFE, 60% conversion, 51% OM and the fade price one margin worry; p_down 0.50 at the bear value adds a fourth. Bull (395) and the AI complex (LESSON-0003) get zero weight; a 25/50/25 mix gives ~US$307, not 315. The idea may be under-set, not merely expensive. [MATERIAL]
6. FX: 31.6 is a period-implied rate, not a quote. A 5% TWD move shifts target to 299-331, kill to 193-213. No ADR-versus-Taiwan-line premium check (2330 absent from cache). [MATERIAL]
7. Pipeline: first revision stamp 10:30:00 was agent-estimated, future-dated against the 10:19 clock, later orchestrator-corrected; two revision stamps one second apart for a prose trim. Disclosed; no estimate moved after 10:15:27. Escalate to QC. [MINOR]
8. Pre-mortem omits a Taiwan/export-control shock and TWD appreciation; 203 is the bear case, not the tail. [MINOR]

**Price at which I stop objecting:** at or below ~240 (EV about +8%, above the ~6% 0.75y hurdle), with Q4'26 OM at or above 55% and revenue QoQ positive.

**Verdict: MAJOR_REVISION**
At 250 the long clears neither the hurdle nor a fill-conditional probability test, and its payoff leg rests on a margin 4pp above the thesis's own cycle mean.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**Entry reset 250 to 240.** p_up 0.50, target 315 and kill 203 unchanged; no new evidence offered. up_pct 31.3 and down_pct -15.4 move only because entry moved; EV +8.0%.

1. Conceded: no FY26 capex or CFO in the dossier, so 60% to 75% conversion rests on FY25 alone. Flagged for the 20-F; not defended.
2. Conceded. Terminal OM 51% is 4pp above the 47.1% mean and rests on three quarters. At 47% base is ~US$290; at 240 that is +20.8% up, -15.4% down, EV ~+2.8%. Positive but thin; the 240 level buys that cushion. Target not changed.
3. Conceded in part. A fill at 240 needs -25% from spot, and the ACWI -3.49% day shows 2.7x beta, so the fill state is risk-off. I do not raise or lower p_up without evidence; sizing must treat the fill as correlated with market stress.
4. Conceded. This is a value limit-buy borrowing a momentum prior. p_up 0.50 is a registry default, not an estimate, and I do not claim otherwise. Archetype label left as filed; the Judge may reclassify.
5. Disputed, no change. The 25/50/25 mix gives ~US$307, 2.5% below 315, within noise, and raising p_up or target needs new evidence I lack. The bull case is already weighted through p_up 0.50. Haircut stacking is a fair warning against lowering the kill further.
6. Conceded. 31.6 is period-implied; a 5% TWD move spans target 299-331 and kill 193-213. No 2330 premium check; TWD spot unavailable. Unfixed; 240 gives partial buffer.
7. Conceded and disclosed; the stamps stay. Escalation to QC is Drew's call.
8. Conceded. 203 is the bear case, not the tail; a Taiwan or export-control shock gaps below it, and TWD appreciation hits ADS value. Sizing must assume a loss beyond 203.

Q4'26 review trigger (OM <55% or QoQ revenue negative) stands as Drew's stop-objecting condition.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**PASS_REDUCED, size_multiplier 0.25, resting limit 240 (valid to 2027-02-20).** Correction applied: the ledger shows 35 kills of 40 and 0% deployment, and LESSON-0003 scored the first TSM kill at +14.3% missed; I am not killing a right-shaped idea over price or open inputs. Lint passes (word-count warning only).

1. Process: stage_log is monotonic (10:15:27, 10:19:35, 10:19:36, 10:19:44 Bear, 10:22:34), actors correct, Bear log present. The agent-estimated 10:30:00 stamp was future-dated, disclosed in-file and corrected; no estimate changed after 10:15:27. A hygiene defect, not a gamed pipeline, so no process kill. Drew's QC escalation is his call; I add no flag.
2. Base rate: p_up 0.50 equals the registry rate; no raise, no unflagged new evidence. Target 315 and kill 203 are DCF-derived, not price-history anchored. Entry 240 is valuation math (EV +8.0% vs ~6% hurdle).
3. Drew's strongest sentence, restated: the payoff rests on terminal OM 4pp above the thesis's own cycle mean, and a 240 fill happens in a risk-off state. True in part: at 47% OM base is ~US$290 and EV ~+2.8% at 240, thin but positive. A sizing scar, not a dispositive flaw.
4. Archetype momentum_continuation is mislabeled (value limit-buy, fails the reversal filter). I take no edge from it; p_up 0.50 is a default, so the 0.25 starter prices that. Reclassification left to registry owners.
5. Load-bearing FCFE conversion lacks FY26 capex/CFO: verify against the 20-F before any add. Tail beyond 203 (Taiwan, export controls, TWD) is unmodelled, another reason for starter size.
6. Deployment: GLOBAL is 100% cash against a benchmark near +11%. A starter limit is the lower-risk ruling than a 60-day lockout. Not at spot (EV about -18.7%); no chase.
7. Review at Q4'26 (OM below 55% or revenue QoQ negative).
